text_block_list.text:
A few days after she attained the glorious honor of becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume,
a victory celebration was hosted by the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I offer my deepest gratitude for arranging such an occasion.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I recall the moment the Triple Crown was won,
goosebumps still prickle my skin.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Even those outside our house
cheered in jubilation, celebrating my victory—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The birth of a Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We have accomplished a momentous feat—
one bearing a weight quite distinct from a maiden GⅠ victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: There is something I must impart here, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To have not only fulfilled my clan's long-cherished wish,
but to have achieved such a monumental feat...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Firmly demonstrating the prestige
of the Rose Kingdom to the people.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: All of this—everyone's cheers, their countless gestures of support, and above all else...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is a summit we could only have reached
through the tireless devotion of my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>.
I offer my utmost respect for your dedication.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Now, the banquet continues—
I truly hope you will enjoy this evening to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Together with this illustrious Trainer of mine.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Toward a future where the crimson rose shall bloom!

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text: Toward a future where the crimson rose blooms!
Perhaps through the Lord of Roses' good graces—afterward, many people offered me warm words.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: To think you could draw such words from the Lord of Roses.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No, what a magnificent achievement—
Allow me to congratulate you once again.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
Please accept my heartfelt congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I had faith that Lady Rose and her team could do it, but to accomplish such a magnificent feat...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text: We'll all be watching over you and cheering for your future triumphs!

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“Entrusting Rose Kingdom to you—
for our clan, that was...”

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
And above all else, for Rose herself,
it was an immense stroke of fortune.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Mother—

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text: I thank you for your continued dedication.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text: Please, continue to look after this child going forward.
choice_data_list: —I swear upon my life to protect you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Heh—

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Butler
text_block_list.text:
—Lady Rose.
Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Butler
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to offer my congratulations.
...Would you care to look up at the sky?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The sky—?
(*Whistle... boom! Boom!*)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: To think—

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Butler
text_block_list.text:
Please accept this modest token of appreciation
from all of us.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Butler
text_block_list.text:
To express our deepest gratitude to the two of them
for achieving such an extraordinary feat—

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Butler
text_block_list.text: Wishing you even greater success in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Butler
text_block_list.text:
Once again, my heartfelt congratulations
on this glorious occasion!

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I shall never forget this great bloom across the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall walk this path to the very end.
Until the day the Rose Kingdom's long-cherished dream is fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Together with him—my dependable, accomplished Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Together with her—my dependable, accomplished Trainer.
